claims.value: Droysen reports Riga governor Essen removed and succeeded by Paulucci during the blockade.
claims.rationale: Page discusses Paulucci’s November correspondence. English rendering (ours): "Riga governor General Essen was removed from office, and General Paulucci became his successor."
